integrity: Full all-order proof is presented. Enumeration through six vertices is an independently executable finite corroboration, not an unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nonempty finite structures with one binary relation representing a total function. Logic has counting and only two variables; it does not allow unary-function terms. The result is a restricted-class equivalence criterion, not identification among all relational structures. Earlier unindexed specialization could imply the theorem; no independent audit performed.
title: Primitive decorated-cycle invariants for two-variable counting logic on finite endofunctions
